desc:
🚀 Welcome to MrReal's Glitch Obby 🚀

Are you ready for the ultimate test of skill, precision, and patience?
Step into a world where bugs become features!

This is officially the best and most advanced glitch obby on the entire Roblox platform! 👑

📈 What Awaits You?
160 Unique Stages powered by glitches.

The game gets harder every 10 levels, scaling from simple, all the way up to eRRoR!!!

Master the Controls: Utilize various keybinds for emotes and clips to outsmart the obstacles.

Show off your skills, master the physics, and prove you are the ultimate glitcher on Roblox!

🛠️ Development Team (Made with 💖) by:

👍 Support the Game!
Enjoying the challenge? Don't forget to leave a LIKE 👍, favorite the game, and join our community to stay updated!
